title: Virus Spread Simulation
description: Model the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 people to understand transmission dynamics.

interactions.name: infection_event
interactions.description: When a person with the virus interacts with a susceptible person, there is a chance of transmission.

metrics.name: total_infected
metrics.description: Total number of people who contracted the virus during the simulation.

metrics.name: peak_infection_day
metrics.description: The day on which the highest number of new infections occurred.

metrics.name: recovered_count
metrics.description: Total number of people who recovered from the virus.

validation_criteria.name: infection_rate_accuracy
validation_criteria.description: The simulated infection rate should be within reasonable bounds compared to known virus transmission rates.

validation_criteria.name: population_stability
validation_criteria.description: The total population should remain constant, except for changes due to virus infection and recovery.
